description: This Java class defines a Vert.x HTTP resource for scraping metrics from a PrometheusMeterRegistry and exposes it via a specific endpoint, '/prometheus'. It is a component that registers a handler to serve metrics data, making it part of a monitoring and metrics collection system.

classes.name: PrometheusScrapingResource
classes.description: A Vert.x handler component that provides an HTTP endpoint for scraping Prometheus metrics from a Micrometer registry.

methods.name: PrometheusScrapingResource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource with a PrometheusMeterRegistry attached to this instance.

methods.name: scrape
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests by scraping the metrics from the registry and responding with the metrics data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Registers the scrape handler on the given Vert.x Router at the endpoint '/prometheus'.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource, including its endpoint URI.
